from tests.test_sfu_transport import SfuTransportTests
async def probe(callback):
    case=SfuTransportTests('test_publish_waits_for_input_ready_and_decodes_audio')

    original=case.transport.request
    async def request(url,method,payload,secret):
        if url.endswith('adapters/websocket/new') and payload['tracks'][0]['location']=='remote':
            if callback:
                case.transport.attach_socket('input',object())
            return 200, {'tracks':[{'adapterId':'allocated-without-audio','trackName':'microphone'}]}
        return await original(url,method,payload,secret)
    case.transport.request=request
    try:
        await case.transport.signal('publish', {'sessionDescription':{'type':'offer','sdp':'v=0\r\n'},'mid':'0'})
        result=await case.transport.signal('input_ready',{})
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        return {'callback':callback,'input_ready_result':result,'socket_attached':case.transport.input_socket is not None,'decoded_audio_chunks':len(case.audio),'input_bytes':case.transport.received_bytes,'errors':case.events}
    finally:
        await case.asyncTearDown()
